infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Band connects to the hub on your local network.

plugins.cameraPermission: Band uses the camera to scan the QR code from Settings > Devices.

plugins.photosPermission: Band reads the photos you pick to attach them to a message.
plugins.cameraPermission: Band uses the camera to take a photo to attach to a message.
plugins.microphonePermission: Band records your voice when you dictate into a message. The audio goes to your hub, which sends it to the speech-to-text service set up in Settings > Voice.
